blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
What usually goes wrong, and the specific guard in this build:

items: Agent sprawl
Agent sprawl, the classic killer; here every agent ships with a role spec, budget and owner — unregistered agents are quarantined at the queue

Duplicated work
Duplicated work — blackboard contracts make task claims exclusive, so two agents can never own the same case
